description: K₂NaBP₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. There are two inequivalent K sites. In the first K site, K is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent B and two equivalent P atoms. Both K-B bond lengths are 3.26 Å. Both K-P bond lengths are 3.38 Å. In the second K site, K is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two equivalent B and four P atoms. Both K-B bond lengths are 3.16 Å. There are a spread of K-P bond distances ranging from 3.34-3.46 Å. Na is bonded to four P atoms to form NaP₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four BK₄P₂ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaP₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaP₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 60-82°. There are three shorter (2.91 Å) and one longer (2.97 Å) Na-P bond length. There are two inequivalent B sites. In the first B site, B is bonded to four equivalent K and two equivalent P atoms to form distorted BK₄P₂ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaP₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent BK₄P₂ octahedra. Both B-P bond lengths are 1.78 Å. In the second B site, B is bonded to four equivalent K and two equivalent P atoms to form distorted BK₄P₂ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaP₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent BK₄P₂ octahedra. Both B-P bond lengths are 1.78 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one K, three equivalent Na, and one B atom. In the second P site, P is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to five K, one Na, and one B atom.
